title: Structured extraction that works in production: json, summary, question and highlights formats over a real Model Plane structured-output grant
summary: Add json (schema plus prompt, strict-schema normalisation, JSON repair), summary, question and highlights as ScrapeOptions formats on scrape and crawl, executed by calling a Model Plane structured-output endpoint over an org-bound, metered model-invoke grant. Today the prompt field is dead code, JSON exists only on /v1/extract, and the cross-plane token manifest denies model-invoke, so extraction only works under dev bypass (SRC). The grant is a tracked deferral (DEF-QB-T17-PART2, owner and date unassigned).
whyItMatters: Schema-to-JSON extraction is the most-used LLM feature of scrape APIs and the basis for monitors, research jobs and extraction profiles. The Model Plane already centralises ZDR-aware model routing, so Quarry should call it rather than hold its own model keys.

referenceBestPractice.mechanism: normalizeSchema (additionalProperties:false, every field required, $ref resolved) then validate for strict mode with clear errors; pick the model by schema complexity ($ref/$defs go to a larger model); trim markdown by character bound then tokenizer to 80 percent of the context; call with response_format json_schema strict; on parse failure run a repair pass; on provider error fall back to the next provider; return data + warnings + token usage. summary, question and highlights are each one LLM call over trimmed markdown (10,000-char inputs) with a fixed instruction, returned as document.summary|answer|highlights; billed per page. || Merged items add: formats:[{type:'json', schema, prompt}] on scrape: convert the page to markdown, call the LLM with schema-constrained output, validate against the schema, return data.json; multi-page work goes through batch or the agent; the old /extract stays with Deprecation headers pointing to the new shape.

verevonToday.gap: AiFormatRunner implements summary, json and query as a library: json is reachable only through POST /v1/extract (schema), query only through /v1/answer, and summary() has no caller outside its own module; there is no highlights format. The schema is pasted into the prompt and checked after the fact (schema_issues), with no strict-mode request, repair pass or provider fallback. StructuredExtractClient (quarry-runtime) targets a Model Plane POST /v1/structured/extract that no Model Plane code serves (grep of apps/Model Plane finds no such route; the gateway exposes /v1/invoke and /v1/ai/*). The model-invoke and model-stream rows of the cross-plane token manifest are granted:false, so QUARRY_EDGE__AI_FORMATS stays off by default and the calls would be refused with 403. || /v1/extract is sequential with no async job, the prompt is unused, schema extraction is refused because the manifest grants quarry-edge no model-gateway request, and the gateway forwards a prompt but never a schema. What works without a model: always-returned JSON-LD and hydration data.

approach: Control Plane: grant the model-gateway audience to quarry-edge (QB-T17). Model Plane: structured-output endpoint with schema-complexity model choice and provider fallback. Ingestion Plane: json/summary/question/highlights formats in the format registry from F-t2-005; batch fan-out for many URLs is F-t2-040. || Source detail: [R-t2-02-02] Model Plane (model-gateway + inference-core): add the structured-output endpoint Quarry already calls (shape in quarry-core contracts.rs:941-957), or extend /v1/invoke with a json_schema response format (verify what InferRequest carries first); own normalisation, complexity-based model choice, 80 percent context trim, one repair pass, provider fallback, cost and ZDR-aware provider choice (routing_policy.rs, fallback.rs, zdr.rs). Control Plane: grant quarry-edge a model-gateway audience with org binding and the ZDR flag (QB-T17 part 2), then flip granted in cross-plane-token-requests.json. Ingestion Plane: add json{schema,prompt}, summary, question, highlights to FormatSpec; run structured harvest first and call the model only for unfilled fields; wire the existing summary_for_org/query_for_org methods; require highlights to be verbatim substrings of the source markdown; reuse the model-gateway injection_defense marker framing for untrusted page text. || [R-t2-01-04] Ingestion Plane quarry-runtime ai_formats.rs and quarry-edge: add the json format to the ScrapeOptions union (R-t2-01-01), implement it through mp_client.rs against the Model Plane (Model Plane owns inference), fold prompt into the schema-guided prompt, treat page content as untrusted in that prompt, and propagate zdr. Control Plane: add the quarry-edge to model-gateway audience to apps/Control Plane/config/plane-service-principals.json and flip model-invoke/model-stream together with it, following the org-bound, metered path (DEF-QB-T17-PART2) so cost lands on the org. Gateway ingestions/runs.rs forwards schema as well as prompt. Keep /v1/extract as a deprecated facade over batch plus the json format.

verevon.exactGap: AiFormatRunner (ai_formats.rs:60-300) implements summary, json and query as a library: json is reachable only through POST /v1/extract with a schema (extract_routes.rs:195-300; sequential, markdown cap 20k, prompt field marked dead_code at 48), query only through /v1/answer, summary has no caller and there is no highlights format; the schema is pasted into the prompt and checked after the call with no strict mode or repair pass, and ModelPlaneInvokeRequest (mp_client.rs:31-40) carries neither structured_output_schema nor zdr (ai_formats.rs:302-310 discards the zdr argument). Every Quarry to Model Plane call is refused today because model-invoke and model-stream are granted:false (cross-plane-token-requests.json:41-65, model_plane_gate.rs), so QUARRY_EDGE__AI_FORMATS stays off, and StructuredExtractClient (structured_extract.rs) posts to a Model Plane /v1/structured/extract route that exists nowhere in apps/Model Plane. What already works: /v1/extract without a schema returns cleaned markdown plus a model-free structured harvest, and the Model Plane itself ships ExtractStructured (model-gateway grpc.rs:2516-2655: Quarry scrape then InferRequest.structured_output_schema, 80k char cap, ZDR-aware) while /v1/invoke already accepts structured_output_schema and zdr (http_routes.rs:6693, 8987).
reuse: model-gateway POST /v1/invoke structured_output_schema and zdr fields with the inference-core OpenAI response_format mapping (openai.rs:463-490); no new Model Plane endpoint is needed
model-gateway ExtractStructured RPC (grpc.rs:2516-2655) as an agent-driven path that needs no Quarry to Model Plane grant
Quarry structured harvest (JSON-LD and hydration data, ExtractedPage.structured) as the model-free first pass
model_plane_gate.rs and the token-request manifest as the single enabling switch once the registry grant lands
gateway ingestions/runs.rs create_extract, which forwards prompt only and must also forward schema
verevon.constraints: Inference is Model Plane-owned. Quarry may call model-gateway only with an org-bound service token, and the Control Plane registry grant is a tracked deferral (D16, QB-T17, DEF-QB-T17-PART2, owner and date unassigned), so the grant is a decision, not an engineering option. ZDR must be forwarded explicitly on the invoke body (currently dropped), and provider strictness differs: OpenAI gets response_format json_schema non-strict while Anthropic gets the schema only through the prompt (anthropic.rs:725-737). Page text is untrusted input, and per-page model cost multiplies in crawls, so it depends on the F-t2-008 budgets.
verevon.approachAdjustment: Do not design a new Model Plane structured-output endpoint: extend ModelPlaneInvokeRequest to send structured_output_schema and zdr to the existing /v1/invoke, add the normalisation and one repair pass in Quarry or as an inference-core option, and treat the Control Plane grant as the gating decision. As an interim or alternative that avoids the grant, extend the existing ExtractStructured RPC (multi-URL, repair, highlights, summary) as the Model-proposed path and keep Quarry scrape formats for the user-facing API once D16 lands. The gateway runs.rs must forward schema as well as prompt.
verevon.effortNote: Unchanged: the Model Plane share is smaller than stated (S, invoke already carries schema and zdr) but the Control Plane grant decision and the F-t2-005 formats contract dominate.
verevon.verdictReason: Status is partial rather than missing and the Model Plane already has two structured-output paths (invoke with schema and ExtractStructured); the item should recommend wiring Quarry to them and resolving the QB-T17 grant instead of building a new endpoint.

reference.corrections: 1) normalizeSchema does not resolve $ref; it normalises $defs in place and routes schemas with $ref/$defs to a larger model. 2) Fallback is to a second model (gpt-4.1-mini, same OpenAI provider) only on quota/rate-limit errors, not 'next provider on provider error'. 3) The 10,000-char figure is the max length of the question/query/prompt text, not the markdown input; question/highlights trim the page by tokens to the model context and summary uses trimToTokenLimit. 4) question/highlights run on a Firecrawl-hosted fine-tuned model (Fireworks) or Gemini through query.ts, not the json-extraction routine. 5) Prevalence: Apify Website Content Crawler offers an optional per-page AI summary (apify-platform-049, DOC), so 'summary' is at least 2 of 4; json/question/highlights as built-in scrape formats remain Firecrawl-only in this record set.
caveats: Firecrawl models are hard-coded to OpenAI families plus a private Fireworks fine-tune and Gemini; Verevon must route through Model Plane
question/highlights depend on a hosted fine-tuned model id; self-hosters may not have it (INF from model id string)
